title: 1955 AHSME Problem 15
statement: The ratio of the areas of two concentric circles is \(1:3.\) If the radius of the smaller is \(r,\) then the difference between the radii is best approximated by:

solutions.text:
If the larger radius is \(R,\) then \[ \frac{\pi r^2}{\pi R^2}=\frac13, \] so \(R=r\sqrt3.\) The difference is \[ R-r=(\sqrt3-1)r\approx0.732r. \]

Thus, the best approximation is \(0.73r,\) and the correct answer is D.
hints: Area ratios are the squares of radius ratios
The larger radius is \(r\sqrt3\), so estimate \(\sqrt3-1\)
